service.description: Export accounting journal entries in Tally-compatible XML format. Generates Tally Day Book XML that can be imported via Tally Gateway.

actions.script:
def sb = new StringBuilder() sb.append('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
') sb.append('<ENVELOPE>
') sb.append(' <HEADER>
') sb.append(' <TALLYREQUEST>Import Data</TALLYREQUEST>
') sb.append(' </HEADER>
') sb.append(' <BODY>
') sb.append(' <IMPORTDATA>
') sb.append(' <REQUESTDESC>
') sb.append(' <REPORTNAME>Vouchers</REPORTNAME>
') sb.append(' <STATICVARIABLES>
') sb.append(' <SVCURRENTCOMPANY>' + (companyName ?: 'Company') + '</SVCURRENTCOMPANY>
') sb.append(' </STATICVARIABLES>
') sb.append(' </REQUESTDESC>
') sb.append(' <REQUESTDATA>
')
journals?.each { journal -> def txnDate = ec.l10n.format(journal.transactionDate, 'yyyyMMdd') def voucherType = 'Journal' if (journal.voucherType == 'Sales') voucherType = 'Sales' else if (journal.voucherType == 'Purchase') voucherType = 'Purchase' else if (journal.voucherType == 'Payment') voucherType = 'Payment' else if (journal.voucherType == 'Receipt') voucherType = 'Receipt' else if (journal.voucherType == 'Contra') voucherType = 'Contra'
sb.append(' <TALLYMESSAGE xmlns:UDF="TallyUDF">
') sb.append(' <VOUCHER VCHTYPE="' + voucherType + '" ACTION="Create">
') sb.append(' <DATE>' + txnDate + '</DATE>
') sb.append(' <VOUCHERTYPENAME>' + voucherType + '</VOUCHERTYPENAME>
') sb.append(' <VOUCHERNUMBER>' + (journal.voucherNumber ?: journal.journalEntryId) + '</VOUCHERNUMBER>
') sb.append(' <NARRATION>' + (journal.description ?: '') + '</NARRATION>
')
// Get line items def lines = ec.entity.find('zenith.erp.accounting.JournalEntryLine') .condition('journalEntryId', journal.journalEntryId).list()
lines?.each { line -> def acctName = '' def acct = ec.entity.find('zenith.erp.accounting.GlAccount') .condition('glAccountId', line.glAccountId).one() if (acct) acctName = acct.accountName ?: acct.glAccountId
if (line.debitAmount && line.debitAmount > 0) { sb.append(' <ALLLEDGERENTRIES.LIST>
') sb.append(' <LEDGERNAME>' + acctName + '</LEDGERNAME>
') sb.append(' <ISDEEMEDPOSITIVE>Yes</ISDEEMEDPOSITIVE>
') sb.append(' <AMOUNT>-' + line.debitAmount + '</AMOUNT>
') sb.append(' </ALLLEDGERENTRIES.LIST>
') } if (line.creditAmount && line.creditAmount > 0) { sb.append(' <ALLLEDGERENTRIES.LIST>
') sb.append(' <LEDGERNAME>' + acctName + '</LEDGERNAME>
') sb.append(' <ISDEEMEDPOSITIVE>No</ISDEEMEDPOSITIVE>
') sb.append(' <AMOUNT>' + line.creditAmount + '</AMOUNT>
') sb.append(' </ALLLEDGERENTRIES.LIST>
') } }
sb.append(' </VOUCHER>
') sb.append(' </TALLYMESSAGE>
') }
sb.append(' </REQUESTDATA>
') sb.append(' </IMPORTDATA>
') sb.append(' </BODY>
') sb.append('</ENVELOPE>')
tallyXml = sb.toString()

service.description: Export GL accounts as Tally Ledger masters

actions.script:
def sb = new StringBuilder() sb.append('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
') sb.append('<ENVELOPE>
') sb.append(' <HEADER>
') sb.append(' <TALLYREQUEST>Import Data</TALLYREQUEST>
') sb.append(' </HEADER>
') sb.append(' <BODY>
') sb.append(' <IMPORTDATA>
') sb.append(' <REQUESTDESC>
') sb.append(' <REPORTNAME>All Masters</REPORTNAME>
') sb.append(' <STATICVARIABLES>
') sb.append(' <SVCURRENTCOMPANY>' + (companyName ?: 'Company') + '</SVCURRENTCOMPANY>
') sb.append(' </STATICVARIABLES>
') sb.append(' </REQUESTDESC>
') sb.append(' <REQUESTDATA>
')
def tallyGroupMap = [ 'ASSET': 'Current Assets', 'LIABILITY': 'Current Liabilities', 'EQUITY': 'Capital Account', 'REVENUE': 'Sales Accounts', 'EXPENSE': 'Purchase Accounts', 'INCOME': 'Direct Incomes', 'COST_OF_GOODS': 'Direct Expenses' ]
accounts?.each { acct -> def tallyGroup = tallyGroupMap[acct.accountClassification] ?: 'Sundry Debtors' sb.append(' <TALLYMESSAGE xmlns:UDF="TallyUDF">
') sb.append(' <LEDGER NAME="' + (acct.accountName ?: acct.glAccountId) + '" ACTION="Create">
') sb.append(' <PARENT>' + tallyGroup + '</PARENT>
') sb.append(' <OPENINGBALANCE>0</OPENINGBALANCE>
') sb.append(' </LEDGER>
') sb.append(' </TALLYMESSAGE>
') }
sb.append(' </REQUESTDATA>
') sb.append(' </IMPORTDATA>
') sb.append(' </BODY>
') sb.append('</ENVELOPE>')
tallyXml = sb.toString()
